title: A Decision-Theoretic Generalization of On-Line Learning and an Application to Boosting
summary: Yoav Freund and Robert E. Schapire published "A Decision-Theoretic Generalization of On-Line Learning and an Application to Boosting" in the 1995 EuroCOLT proceedings. The paper describes a new boosting algorithm derived from a multiplicative weight-update framework that does not require prior knowledge of the weak learner's performance.
significance: A documented machine-learning milestone in boosting, preserved at year precision from the original Springer proceedings record and institutional bibliographic corroboration.
